issues.title: Ambiguous Error Handling for Checksum Download Failure
issues.why: 04-checksums-verification.md states the installer should 'warn but NOT skip verification' if checksums.txt fails to download, but then says it 'must exit with an error'.
issues.fix: Explicitly mandate a hard exit with code 1 if checksums.txt cannot be retrieved.

issues.title: Inconsistent Placeholder Syntax
issues.why: 03-install-scripts.md uses VERSION_PLACEHOLDER while 09-placeholder-tokens.md (referenced in changelog) mentions modern __VERSION__ syntax, creating potential confusion for template implementation.
issues.fix: Standardize on one placeholder format (e.g., __VERSION__) across all script templates and documentation.

issues.title: Missing Binary Mode Bit Specification for Windows
issues.why: AC-09 specifies 0755 for POSIX but doesn't define expectations for Windows binary attributes within the .zip archive.
issues.fix: Add a clause stating Windows binaries should be packaged without specific read-only attributes to ensure overwrite capability.
